name: 预言家
subject: A charcoal crystal ball on a brick-red short pedestal, a single antique-gold four-point star centered inside the ball. Simple solid silhouettes, no eyes.

name: 赌徒
subject: One brick-red rounded square die with three large circular gold pips, slightly tilted, backed by a single charcoal spade silhouette. Two shapes only.

name: 夜行者

subject: Two chunky charcoal rising bars with a brick-red upward diagonal arrow, one antique-gold coin at their base. Simple compact growth investment symbol, no numbers.

name: 黑卡
subject: One upright charcoal rounded rectangular card, centered large antique-gold circle half blocked with charcoal so it reads as a half disc. Small brick-red offset edge behind. Extremely simple.

name: 绑匪

name: 调包令
subject: Two overlapping rounded playing cards, charcoal and brick red, with gold curved swapping arrows and large diamond cutouts.
